risk_if_not_implemented: Without Sensitive Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Data, malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Storage Capacity
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to allocate and proactively manage sufficient event log and security-relevant telemetry storage capacity to reduce the likelihood of such capacity being exceeded.
compensating_control_1.justification: Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Storage Capacity (MON-10) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Sensitive Event Log Information (MON-30) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Centralized Collection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a Security Incident Event Manager (SIEM), or similar automated tool, to support the centralized collection of event logs and security-relevant telemetry.
compensating_control_2.justification: Centralized Collection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry (MON-05) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Sensitive Event Log Information (MON-30) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
